title: The Greatest Testimony
verse: He replied, “I do not know whether he is a sinner. I do know one thing—that although I was blind, now I can see.
observation: This is possibly the greatest testimony in the Bible. When the man is asked how he can explain what happened to him, he says he can’t fully answer all their questions. He just knows he was one way and now he is another. That. Is. Awesome. It’s simple but true. Sometimes we overcomplicate Christianity. The bottom line is Jesus has saved us. We were one way and now we are another. Boom!
application: Think about your story. Who would you be without Jesus?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for changing us into Your glory one day at a time.
